summary: ISQ Open Infrastructure Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $60 million revolving credit agreement (expandable to $180 million) on June 11, 2026, as a routine financing arrangement. The borrower is the Series II registered series of the company. Revolving loans bear interest at SOFR + 3.00% per annum. The facility matures in June 2028 with one potential 364-day extension. Key covenants include a maximum loan-to-value ratio of 30% with mandatory prepayment triggers above 25%. Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation acts as administrative agent, lead arranger, and lender. This is a standard credit facility creation, not a special situation event.
